{{Quote|Ghost Company, let's move.|Commander Cody, during the Battle of Ryloth|<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth">{{TCW|Innocents of Ryloth}}</ref>}}
'''Ghost Company''' was a company of [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], part of the [[212th Attack Battalion/Legends|212th Attack Battalion]] of [[Clone Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody's]] [[7th Sky Corps/Legends|7th Sky Corps]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was often personally led by Commander Cody. These clone troopers wore orange-marked [[Clone trooper armor/Legends|armor]].<ref name="SWE Cody" />

==History==
===Battle of Ryloth===
After the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] invaded [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] and enslaved its [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] inhabitants, the Republic mounted a bold offensive to free them. [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], destroyed the Separatist blockade surrounding the planet under the command of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Mar Tuuk/Legends|Mar Tuuk]], and the [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ships]] were able to move in to invade and free the planet.

[[File:Ghost_Company2.png|thumb|left|200px|Waxer, Boil, Wooley and Commander Cody scout out the village of Nabat on Ryloth.]]
Under the command of [[High Jedi General/Legends|General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Marshal Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]], Ghost Company boarded [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|gunships]] to land in the city of [[Nabat/Legends|Nabat]]. Unfortunately, heavy fire from [[Proton cannon/Legends|proton cannons]] forced the ''Acclamator'' transports to retreat, leaving Ghost Company to take out the guns and allow the transports to land, forcing them to suffer heavy casualties. After encountering starved [[Gutkurr/Legends|gutkurrs]], the squadron met the young Twi'lek [[Numa/Legends|Numa]], who was able to lead them to the Twi'lek prisoners being used as "living shields" by [[T-series tactical droid/Legends|Tactical droid]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]] [[TX-20/Legends|TX-20]]. Ghost Company created a diversion while the troopers [[Waxer/Legends|Waxer]] and [[Boil/Legends|Boil]] helped Obi-Wan free the hostages and destroy the proton cannons.
